correctness.rationale: For binary closed-neighborhood Lights Out, subtracting vertex equations within one independent part forces a common press bit y_i. With epsilon_i=n_i mod2 and t=sum_j epsilon_j y_j, each part equation is (1+epsilon_i)y_i+t=1 over F2. If no odd parts all y_i=1 is the unique clearing vector; otherwise every odd part forces t=1 and every even part y_i=0, leaving parity-odd selections of odd parts. This yields the full press-set polynomial [prod_{odd}(1+z^{n_i})-prod_{odd}(1-z^{n_i})]/2, 2^{o-1} solutions, and minimal support min odd part size. The homogeneous equation similarly has dimension max(o-1,0), so A+I invertible iff o<=1. Independent explicit toggling-mask exhaustive checks over multiple multipartite profiles (including 5 odd singleton parts) match the formula and count. The proof applies arbitrary r,n_i, not merely bounded enumerations.
